question: Approve the cli-host-flag ideation design — a --host CLI flag + bind-conditional _local_ok relaxation (0.0.0.0 bind admits remote Hosts; default loopback unchanged), 5 falsifiable ACs — to proceed to implementation?

artifacts.summary: A --host CLI flag (default 127.0.0.1) threaded to the single bind tuple + spawn_argv; the Host gate (_local_ok) becomes bind-conditional so a 0.0.0.0 bind admits remote Hosts while the default loopback posture and Origin/Sec-Fetch-Site checks stay. Spike confirmed the riskiest mechanism: a 0.0.0.0 bind alone leaves every remote request 403 via _local_ok, so bind-conditional admission is required. Five ACs with external falsifying edits. Backend-only, no mock.
